request.style: English, deep male baritone, solo with backing choir, slide guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, Hammond organ, mournful and hopeful, 78 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Some trust in chariots and some in horses
They lean on steel and speed on the roads
We call on the name of the LORD our God
We put our faith in his endless loads

[Pre-Chorus]
He answers from his holy heaven high
With the saving power of his right hand
Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed one
He holds us when the days are bad

[Chorus]
They are brought to their knees and fall
But we rise up and stand firm
May the LORD fulfill every request you make
We shout for joy in the name of the Lord

[Verse]
May he give you what your heart desires
And bring all your plans to pass
We raise our banners in the name of our God
Looking to the one who is above us all

[Chorus]
They are brought to their knees and fall
But we rise up and stand firm
May the LORD fulfill every request you make
We shout for joy in the name of the Lord

[Bridge]
Not in chariots nor in horses do we trust
Only in the name of the LORD our God
He saves the king when we cry out to him
His power is strong on the mountain and the road

[Outro]
We rise up and stand firm
We rise up and stand firm
